atomic_facts.fact: Sam Bankman-Fried was convicted of fraud (and conspiracy) charges by a jury
The jury's verdict convicting Sam Bankman-Fried came in November 2023
Sam Bankman-Fried was sentenced to 25 years in federal prison
On June 12, 2026, the United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit upheld Sam Bankman-Fried's fraud conviction
The Second Circuit refused to vacate/overturn Sam Bankman-Fried's conviction and 25-year sentence
